title: Agent-file drift check covers bee-build and names a herding slot honestly
action: REWORK ROUND 2 — the previous round landed as commit 44ca1065 and is GOOD except for one FAIL. Do not redo it; make one focused correction on top. FAILING CHECK (goal-check judge, high confidence): packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/status_full/store.rs at lines 920, 959 and 966 each end their remedy with `re-run the installer (\`scripts/install.sh\`) in a host repo`. That path does not exist in a host repo: the installer writes `$TARGET_DIR/.bee/bin` (scripts/install.sh:583) and copies no `scripts/` tree into the target, so the message names a file the reader cannot run — the same defect the cell was written to remove. bee already spells the host-repo remedy correctly in its own no-engine refusal at packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/onboard/mod.rs:296-298, as the fetchable one-liner `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thanhsmind/beehive/main/scripts/install.sh | bash -s -- -y`. Replace the host-repo half of all three remedies with that one-liner, keeping the bee-checkout half (`bee onboard --apply`) exactly as it is. Prefer taking the string from the existing constant or helper that mod.rs:296-298 uses rather than re-typing the URL, so the two can never drift; if it is a bare inline literal there, lift it to one shared constant and use it in both places. Update any test that pins the old `scripts/install.sh` wording. Everything else about the cell's original contract still holds unchanged.
